title: Attractive and easy to assemble
text:
Attractive and easy to assemble. The directions on putting this bed together are clear and easy to follow. There are a lot of pieces, but follow the step by step instructions and you will have no problems.

It took 2 of us maybe 45 minutes to an hour to put it together. I didn't time it, but that's my best guess.

My daughter loves her bed. It looks great in her room and the headboard is comfortable for her to lean against (with a pillow in her lower back).

Something to remember is to put the slates with the arch up, you don't want them to be like a U. I feel the bed is well supported and looks great in her room. The bed is a little low without a box spring, but it's what we wanted. Her bed was way too high before.

description: Elegance, sophistication and modern comfort define the Better Homes & Gardens Porter Upholstered Bed. Upholstered in premium linen, this bed has a mid-century style headboard that features tufted details. Made with a robust wood frame and tapered brown legs, it comes with a bentwood slat system provides great ventilation. In fact, the slat base allows air to pass freely beneath your mattress, keeping it fresher longer. It also comes with additional metal side rails and center legs provide extra support and stability, without requiring a foundation. Available in multiple sizes and colors, this lavish bed will style up your room!
